import pyknotid.spacecurves as sp
from pyknotid import cinvariants
from pyknotid.spacecurves import ccomplexity
from pyknotid.invariants import _crossing_arrows_and_signs_numpy

k = sp.Knot(mk.trefoil())
r = k.gauss_code(recalculate=True)
arrows, signs = _crossing_arrows_and_signs_numpy(r, np.arange(1, len(r)+1))
print("arrows dtype:", arrows.dtype, arrows.shape, "first:", arrows[:2].tolist())
direct = cinvariants.vassiliev_degree_3(arrows)
print("cinvariants.vassiliev_degree_3(arrows) =", direct)
assert int(round(direct)) == -1, direct

# ccomplexity direct call
n = 8
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
points = rng.normal(size=(n,3)).astype(np.float64)
contributions = np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if i!=j:
            contributions[i,j] = rng.normal()
order = np.array([0,1,2,3], dtype=np.int64)
res = ccomplexity.cython_higher_order_writhe(points, contributions, order)
print("cython_higher_order_writhe =", res)
print("ALL DIRECT EXTENSION CALLS OK")
EOF

import numpy as np
import pyknotid.make as mk
import pyknotid.spacecurves as sp
from pyknotid.spacecurves import chelpers

# Mirror spacecurve.py gauss_code() cython call exactly
k = sp.Knot(mk.trefoil())
points = k.points
segment_lengths = np.roll(points[:, :2], -1, axis=0) - points[:, :2]
segment_lengths = np.sqrt(np.sum(segment_lengths * segment_lengths, axis=1))
max_segment_length = np.max(segment_lengths[:-1])
i = 0
v0 = points[i]
dv = points[(i+1) % len(points)] - v0
s = points[i+2:]
crossings = chelpers.find_crossings(v0, dv, s, segment_lengths[i+2:],
                                    i, i+2, max_segment_length, 1)
print("chelpers.find_crossings returned", len(crossings), "crossings for vertex", i)
print("chelpers.find_crossings OK (matches package usage)")

# Also confirm gauss_code cython vs python agree (the real in-context test)
k2 = sp.Knot(mk.trefoil())
g1 = k2.gauss_code(recalculate=True, try_cython=True)
g2 = k2.gauss_code(recalculate=True, try_cython=False)
print("cython gauss == python gauss:", str(g1) == str(g2))
assert str(g1) == str(g2)
print("CHHELPERS VERIFIED IN CONTEXT")
EOF
